title: Away Mode: One Task at a Time Without Losing the TV Bonus | vitalii.no
description:
When one of my boys stays at his grandmother's for a few days, there's no home TV and no camera to track him there — but the family screen-time system still judged him by the same rules as if he were home. Finishing a task set away, with no bonus task to gate it, was read as "done but unpaid," which shut down YouTube for his brothers who were actually home and watching.

I added a server-side away_mode flag in settings that any phone can toggle from the Tasks page. While it's on, the away child gets one subject's task prepared at a time instead of a full daily set, with no cap and no bonus required. In the YouTube-gate Cloudflare Worker, a new check reads every away_mode key and excludes those children from the active set, so an away child can no longer be mistaken for a "done without a bonus" offender at home. The flag clears automatically the moment the home camera recognizes him again.

The fix closes the exact bug that forced it: a completed task set with no active bonus used to shut down YouTube for the brothers who were actually home. That false shutdown now happens zero times, and the away child keeps working through tasks one at a time for as long as he needs.
